critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1165 lines (grew from 1029). Splitting into modules (auth, admin, payments, subscriptions, booking, cron) is increasingly needed.

_run_subscription_reminders sets renewal_reminder_for even when WhatsApp is not sent (no phone / Twilio unset). That is fine for idempotency but means once Twilio is configured, existing subs whose reminder_for was already stamped will NOT receive a message for that renewal date. Consider only stamping when a message was actually attempted, or storing separate 'reminder_attempted_for' vs 'reminder_sent_for'.
admin_earnings uses appointment.total_cents (may be None) — safe due to `or 0`, but ensure new appointment writes always populate total_cents so historical revenue stays consistent.

Cancelled subscriptions still contribute to sub_cents in that month if they were active any time in the month (via updated_at cutoff). That is a reasonable convention, but consider tracking cancelled_at explicitly instead of reusing updated_at (which changes on any mutation).
usage count only counts appointments whose created_at >= period start; if backfill/imports happen, historical usage may be miscounted. Consider basing period on appointment.date instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Ganhos tab, usage bars, client cancel)
